text.tspan: PAT (source NAT) in action: what each hop sees, and how the reply finds its way back
The router's conntrack entry (tested): one line, both directions
original direction (as the laptop sent it)
reply direction (what the router expects back)
Without the MASQUERADE rule (tested): the SYNs still reach the web server, but from 192.168.1.10,
a private address it has no route to. The laptop sees curl: (28) … Timeout was reached
